_comment: PCK-20 (docs/audits/platform-parity/2026-11-21-pickers-prompts/report.md). What the prompt editor's host saves from one page message, on the three drivers: the name is trimmed of Lua %s whitespace (space, tab, line feed, vertical tab, form feed, carriage return), the prompt is kept byte for byte, a name or a prompt that is blank once trimmed and a batch that is not a Boolean are refused. Windows replays it through _PromptEdWeb_ReadSavePayload, macOS through the prompt editor's bridge callback, Linux through ai/ui/prompt_editor/bridge on_message. A Windows JSON Boolean is the Integer 0 or 1, so no vector sends a number as batch.

unknown_actions._comment: An action the page never sends is a page defect: each host logs one WARNING line naming it and saves nothing.
